pixel_description: Pixel-first view of annotated render only: title top 'Concealed Twin Under-Deck TMD Retrofit' / '40 m Footbridge Midspan'. Center is footbridge deck at midspan with railings left and right, deck slightly arched upward. Red arrow from top labeled 'crowd-induced vibration dynamic load' with down arrow onto deck joint, blue double-arrow labeled 'deck vibration motion' along deck. Below deck is large dark longitudinal beam labeled 'Longitudinal girder SHS 200x200x8 mm', with cross frames labeled 'Existing cross-girder below deck at midspan'. Hung below that via U-shaped threaded rods with nuts is a transverse dark beam with light grey saddle plates labeled 'Transverse clamp beam SHS 100x6mm' and 'M20 U-bolt' (two leader labels). From each saddle (left and right stations) hang two outer coil springs and one central piston damper down to a large black rectangular block. Left block labeled 'TMD mass block 250kg x2' and 'Coil spring 1.81 Hz 20.0 mm travel' pointing to left spring, 'Viscous damper' pointing to right-side spring/damper area, vertical dimension arrow labeled '320 mm compression travel' spanning spring height. Both black blocks carry blue vertical double-arrows labeled 'oscillation' on left and 'vertical oscillation' with up-down symbols on right, showing vertical motion. Small light box under left mass labeled 'Soffit access hatch'. Bottom left box 'Fixed: Transverse clamp beam & girder secured to structure' with '~500 mm' scale bar, bottom right box 'Moving: TMD mass + spring + damper oscillates to counter vibration'. Right side list 'Force path: Deck vibration / Girder / Clamp beam / Springs/Damper / TMD mass' with small arrows. Physical connections visible: U-bolt loops wrap over host beam and bolt through clamp plate, springs hooked between clamp plate underside and mass top, damper cylinder bolted between clamp plate center and mass top. Footer 'Conceptual illustration - physical performance not established'.

requirements.detail: Twin TMD mass blocks, coil springs, viscous dampers, transverse clamp beams with M20 U-bolts, existing girders, deck, soffit hatch all depicted; counts consistent with twin-unit concept.
Masses hung on springs and damped by dampers hung from clamp beams, clamp beams U-bolted to host cross-girder/girder below deck antinode - same topology as schematic.
Mass blocks largest (~500 mm scale), springs/dampers slender vertical (~320 mm length, 20 mm travel noted), clamp beams long transverse - relative sizes plausible and within size classes.
Vertical blue oscillation arrows on both masses and deck vibration motion arrow show counter-oscillation operating moment.
Crowd dynamic load arrow into deck plus Force path list Deck->Girder->Clamp beam->Springs/Damper->TMD mass shows load in and dissipation path.

notes: Render is photorealistic side/below-deck view, not a diagram. 320 mm dimension spans spring free length (compatible with 100-400 mm spring size class) while 20.0 mm is damper relative travel - both can coexist, no contradiction. Twin masses each show 2 coil coils in parallel + central damper representing one tuned spring-damper unit per 250kg mass.
